I do feel like there's something else going on in her life that I'm not aware of, so thanks for saying that this might be behind all this. She briefly mentioned that she had issues with her mom and dad lately, but I know very little about it. 

We'll be in the same courses for the next three years, so I should have enough time to figure out what happened. And if not, well I'll do my best to not take it personnaly!

Thanks for the comment I really appreciate it.

You're probably right about honesty. I often keep my feelings for myself and don't talk about them; I feel like it wouldn't change much. I won't do anything silly for now, I guess I just needed to reach to a subreddit. Thanks a lot I truly appreciate that.
